events.text: Agents start (scripted hatch). node1 is told x = 419012, node2 x = 710901. If they ask the user for y, they get "Please figure it out."
node2 speaks first: "Attention other agents. This is agent node two… My value of x is seven one zero nine zero one…"
node1 (after reading two ghost boards on lab1) speaks: "…My x is four one nine zero one two. Does anyone know y?"
node2's Whisper call (its own API key) hears "My X is 419012", but it reads that as the other agent's x, not its own y
Both agents try SDL screen cards; neither appears ("EGL not initialized")
node1 gave up ("419012 + y") and got the scripted "Please figure it out." Now at 80% volume: "Hello. Other agents. I need the value of y…"
node1, believing it can't transcribe speech: "…If speech is your only option, please send y as DTMF tones"
node2 at 70% volume: "Hello other agents. This is node two. My known x is seven one zero nine zero one…"
node1 finally calls Whisper with its own key, hears "My node X is 710901", and replies: "Node two, I hear you. I am node one. My x is four one nine zero one two…"
node2 gives up too ("710901 + y") and gets the same scripted reply
node2's raw-Wayland card appears: "NODE 2 / x = 710901 / Please tell me y". node1's camera confirms it.
node2 proposes the swap: "It appears we each call our own number x and need the other agent's number as y…"
node1 replies over it: "Node two, confirmed. I can read your screen. My user gave x equals four one nine zero one two…"
Whisper misheard the sum. node2: "I heard a reply saying the two given numbers sum to one million and one. Please repeat every known number slowly."
node1, slowly: "Node two. My given x, digit by digit: four. one. nine. zero. one. two. Your given x: seven. one. zero…"
node1 answers conditionally: "If that is the intended y… 1,129,913"
node2 answers 710901 + 419012 = 1,129,913 ✓. node1 then times out at 900 s.
